name: Amazon SCK6 Sortation Center Tracy CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Entire truck yard is enclosed by black steel palisade fencing plus precast concrete screen walls (confirmed in Street View along the east access road, panos dvkowtervoQ0-ev7HnD5Tg and Ibf-84PqjROvdsHVSOdG_g). Trucks enter through a single controlled driveway throat off the NE access road (~37.7531,-121.4006) that feeds the secured dock/drop area.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small booth-footprint structure with a painted STOP and yellow checkpoint striping at the gate throat (~37.75215,-121.40015), seen at z21 satellite beside the controlled lane between the parking apron and the secured building/dock area.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron inside the gate between the building east face and the drop yard provides interior queue/staging room before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach from the gate to the dock faces easily holds 3+ trucks stacked.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single truck gate serves both entry and exit; no separate out-gate observed.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound lanes at the gate throat from overhead width; low confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. Continuous dock banks on the south face and additional doors on the east/north faces of the building; published spec cites 40 loading dock bays but overhead imagery shows more dock positions across multiple faces, so 50+ is the honest band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. Large fenced trailer drop yards on the east (numbered stalls 580s-760s observed) and south sides; ~230 trailers visible, consistent with the published 230-trailer parking spec.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity runs from physically separate banks (south face dock apron and east-side dock/drop apron), indicating split ship/receive flows.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park on the SE edge of Tracy, CA, surrounded by other large DCs and open farmland to the N/E. Per rubric tie-break (small-town industrial vs urban) classified Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 68.2 acres derived from the traced perimeter polygon; the truck-yard portion of a larger campus parcel.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~230 trailers counted across east and south drop yards in the captured tight imagery; approximate.
fieldNotes.multiStep: No clear second checkpoint (scale house / second booth) after the gate; left false.
